_note: Models offered on the Welcome screen and in Settings → Models. Sizes in bytes; licences checked on Hugging Face 2026-10-11.

models.name: Ornith 1.5 9B
models.summary: Recommended for 8 GB graphics cards: a 9B model fine-tuned for agent work and coding. Fast and capable.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.summary: Small and quick: for graphics cards under 8 GB, or running on the CPU without a GPU.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (3-bit)
models.summary: Smarter mixture-of-experts model. Part of it runs from system RAM: needs 32 GB RAM to be comfortable; slower than the 9B.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (2-bit)
models.summary: The same model compressed harder to fit 16 GB of RAM. Quality and tool use suffer at 2-bit.
